subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the existing attempt callback field remain a supported compatibility alias, or is OpenClaw committing to a documented deprecation and removal path?
rationale: The patch changes the lifecycle signal of an existing callback contract; repository policy does not permit automation to invent a deprecation or removal commitment.

options.title: Keep the alias supported
options.body: Remove the deprecation marker now while adding the two explicit fields, leaving any future retirement to a separately approved compatibility change.

options.title: Approve a deprecation plan
options.body: Retain the marker only with maintainer-approved migration guidance, compatibility coverage, and a named removal timeline.

options.title: Redesign the internal contract
options.body: If this helper is strictly internal, migrate all callers to one canonical field shape and remove unnecessary aliases in the same change.

recommendation.title: Keep the alias supported
recommendation.body: Remove the deprecation marker now while adding the two explicit fields, leaving any future retirement to a separately approved compatibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the related same-key retry behavior and provides the strongest available routing signal for the callback contract.
